newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-CARSON OUT OF HOSPITAL.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-CARSON OUT OF HOSPITAL.

text.p: Willie Carson has left hospital less than a fortnight after his serious accident at Newbury race course.
Consultant surgeon Myrddin Rees decided the jockey was well enough to convalesce, the hospital said on Thursday.
Carson needed treatment for liver and rib injuries, plus pneumonia, after being kicked by his horse in the Newbury paddock on September 20.
